Tylenol
® Cold plus Flu plus Cough
Night

text.paragraph: Acetaminophen 325 mg Pain reliever/ fever reducer
Dextromethorphan HBr 10 mg Cough suppressant
Doxylamine Succinate 6.25 mg Antihistamine
Phenylephrine HCl 5 mg Nasal decongestant

list.item:
temporarily relieves these common cold/flu symptoms:
minor aches and pains
headache
sore throat
nasal congestion
runny nose and sneezing
cough
sinus congestion and pressure
relieves cough to help you sleep

text.paragraph: This product contains acetaminophen. Severe liver damage may occur if you take

list.item: more than 4,000 mg of acetaminophen in 24 hours
3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product

text.paragraph: Allergy alert: acetaminophen may cause severe skin reactions. Symptoms may include:
If a skin reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away.
If sore throat is severe, persists for more than 2 days, is accompanied or followed by fever, headache, rash, nausea, or vomiting, consult a doctor promptly.

list.item: with any other drug containing acetaminophen (prescription or nonprescription). If you are not sure whether a drug contains acetaminophen, ask a doctor or pharmacist.

if you are now taking a prescription monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) (certain drugs for depression, psychiatric or emotional conditions, or Parkinson's disease), or for 2 weeks after stopping the MAOI drug. If you do not know if your prescription drug contains an MAOI, ask a doctor or pharmacist before taking this product.
if you have ever had an allergic reaction to this product or any of its ingredients

section.title: Ask a doctor before use if you have

list.item: trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland
a breathing problem such as emphysema or chronic bronchitis
persistent or chronic cough such as occurs with smoking, asthma or emphysema
cough that occurs with too much phlegm (mucus)

section.title: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are

list.item: taking the blood thinning drug warfarin
excitability may occur, especially in children
alcohol, sedatives and tranquilizers may increase drowsiness
be careful when driving a motor vehicle or operating machinery

section.title: Stop use and ask a doctor if

list.item: pain, nasal congestion or cough gets worse or lasts more than 7 days
fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days
cough comes back or occurs with rash or headache that lasts

text.paragraph: These could be signs of a serious condition.

code.displayName: OTC - PREGNANCY OR BREAST FEEDING SECTION

text.paragraph: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.

code.displayName: OTC - KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN SECTION

paragraph.content: Keep out of reach of children.

text.paragraph: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. (1-800-222-1222) Quick medical attention is critical for adults as well as for children even if you do not notice any signs or symptoms.

item.content:
do not take more than directed (see
overdose warning)

list.item: use only enclosed dosing cup designed for use with this product. Do not use any other dosing device.

tr.td: adults and children 12 years and over

list.item: take 30 mL in the dosing cup provided every 4 hours while symptoms last
do not take more than 150 mL in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor

item.content: do not use if neck band imprinted with "TYLENOL COLD+FLU+COUGH" or foil inner seal imprinted with "SAFETY SEAL®" is broken or missing
